Key.English:
Class names of the headgear the
character wears her braid with,
separated by commas.

Everything that inherits from one of
them counts as well.

With * and ? an entry is a pattern
for the class name, for example
H_Cap_* or *Beret*.

Default: the baseball caps, where the
braid comes out through the opening
at the back.

Class names of the headgear the
character wears her bun with,
separated by commas.

Everything that inherits from one of
them counts as well.

With * and ? an entry is a pattern
for the class name, for example
H_Helmet* or *_hs.

This list goes before the one for
the braid.

A character switches between her
braid and her bun with what she wears
on her head, by the settings below.

Off: she always has the hair of the
face that was picked for her.

The hair while nothing is worn on
the head.

As picked: the hair of the face that
was picked for the character.

The hair under headgear that is in
neither of the two lists below.

Default: the bun, because a braid
goes through a helmet.
